channel.title: Book Summary on Steven A. Rodríguez
channel.description: Recent content in Book Summary on Steven A. Rodríguez

item.title: If You Build It, Nobody Is Coming
item.description: The build-first reflex feels like progress. James Sinclair calls it the fastest way to ship a non-solution nobody wanted.

item.title: Earn the Right: A First-Time Founder's Guide to Starting a Startup
item.description: James Sinclair's Earn the Right framework in plain terms: prove the problem, win the market, and walk backwards from failure.

item.title: Rehearse It Before You Run It
item.description: The book argues vivid mental rehearsal builds real infrastructure. How to picture the work before you do it.

item.title: Me-Go to We-Go
item.description: Wekigai moves the center from Me to We. Why your impact scales when you stop holding it alone.

item.title: Stop Confusing Tasks With Actions
item.description: A task is a chore. An action is a process built to produce an outcome. Telling them apart is the whole job.

item.title: Your Brain Is a Bad Time Traveler
item.description: We shrink the future to feed the present. A short look at the bias that quietly runs your worst choices.

item.title: You Are Working at a Fraction of What You've Got
item.description: The book argues most people run far below capacity. A note on the ceiling you set without noticing.

item.title: You Are Mostly Running on Tape
item.description: The book argues most of who you are is memorized by mid-life. Why that is a warning, not a sentence.

item.title: When Did You Stop Playing?
item.description: Adult play is not a break from serious work. It is where dormant problem-solving wakes back up.

item.title: Don't Waste the Bad Mood
item.description: High performers feed on discomfort rather than dodge it. A short note on using a hard emotion as fuel.

item.title: The Urge to Push Harder Is a Smoke Alarm
item.description: When you feel the pull to grind harder, treat it as a warning light — an upstream system out of true, not a willpower gap.

item.title: Every Action Is a Vote
item.description: Real change is identity change. Each small action is a vote for the person you are practicing to become.

item.title: Grinder, Striver, Aligner, Exponential
item.description: Four tiers of aligned effort — and why naming your tier honestly is the move that changes it.

item.title: Your Effort Is Leaving as Heat
item.description: Busy is not the same as moving. A look at the Grinder's design flaw — effort that burns off as heat instead of motion.

item.title: The Exponential Individual Playbook: A Field Guide to Aligned Effort
item.description: A working read of 'The Exponential Individual Playbook' — purposeless productivity, aligned effort, and the systems that turn grind into motion.

item.title: Importance over urgency: the calendar audit
item.description: Urgent things shout; important things disappear. Tony Robbins' calendar audit to buy back a day a month.

item.title: Your values are a decision engine
item.description: Hard decisions are usually values conflicts. Tony Robbins on ranking your values so the tough calls get cheap.

item.title: Identity is the ceiling
item.description: You act like the person you think you are. Tony Robbins on why identity is the real ceiling on a team's growth.

item.title: Learned helplessness is the quiet killer
item.description: The deadliest belief on a team is that effort won't move the score. Tony Robbins on learned helplessness and how to break it.

item.title: The words your team uses about failure
item.description: The word you pick is the temperature you feel. Tony Robbins on how a team's language about failure shapes its next move.

item.title: The one question that changes every standup
item.description: Ask a better question, get a better room. Tony Robbins on the habitual questions that decide what your team notices.

item.title: The 1% rule for compounding teams
item.description: Big leaps are loud; compounding is quiet and wins. Tony Robbins' CANI! and the 1% rule for teams that scale.

item.title: Why your rollout stalls
item.description: Logic was never the lever. Tony Robbins on wiring pain and pleasure so your rollout actually sticks.

item.title: How to actually change someone's mind
item.description: You can't argue someone into a new belief. Tony Robbins on changing minds with evidence and small wins, not a deck.

item.title: Raise your standards (goals aren't enough)
item.description: Teams adopt AI to the level of their standards, not their tools. Tony Robbins on raising the floor, not the ceiling.

item.title: What a real decision actually is
item.description: A real decision cuts off every other option. Tony Robbins on why half-decisions cost teams more than wrong ones.

item.title: The Niagara Syndrome — Why Smart Teams Drift Into Crisis (Tony Robbins)
item.description: Tony Robbins' Niagara Syndrome, for operators: teams rarely choose a bad outcome — they drift toward one. How to decide upstream.

item.title: Awaken the Giant Within — Summary, Key Lessons, and How to Use Them
item.description: A builder's summary of Tony Robbins' book 'Awaken the Giant Within' — decisions, beliefs, the Master System, and how to actually use them.
